title: Following the party line: A calendar of key Chinese government and Communist Party meetings
gist: MERICS publishes a calendar of key Chinese party and state meetings; recent readouts show the Politburo prepping the Fifth Plenum around party discipline while State Council readouts admit weak economic performance and insufficient domestic demand.

themes.theme: Party agenda ahead of Fifth Plenum

insights.claim: The Politburo has spent recent months preparing for the Fifth Plenum of the CCP Central Committee, focusing on strict governance of the party and on resolving problems of 'party building'.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: Watch the Fifth Plenum outcomes as a signal of political priority over economic stimulus.

insights.claim: State-side meeting readouts openly admit 'weakness in economic performance' and that insufficient domestic demand remains prominent, showing economic issues are front and center for the government.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: Official acknowledgement of weak demand raises odds of policy support; monitor for stimulus signals.

insights.claim: MERICS compiles open-source information on regular party-state meetings, with summaries of outcomes and previews of upcoming agendas, searchable by term.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: A reference tool for tracking the timing and agenda of China policy-setting meetings.
